stories.title: Write Blog Post: 3-Day JB Backpacker Itinerary Under RM250 (2026)
stories.description: Create a detailed, budget-conscious 3-day itinerary for backpackers visiting Johor Bahru, including accommodation, food, and activities all under RM250 total budget. Include real pricing, transport tips, and local recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Blog post file created at site/src/content/blog/3-day-jb-itinerary.tsx with frontmatter: title, slug, date, author, tags, featuredImage
Itinerary structured with Day 1/2/3 sections and HowTo JSON-LD sub-schema (step-by-step breakdown)
Post appears in /blog list view with excerpt, reading time estimate, and featured image thumbnail
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/content/blog/3-day-jb-itinerary.tsx using existing blog post template
Reuse BlogPostLayout component and existing frontmatter pattern from adjacent blog posts
Test command: npx next build && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/3-day-jb-itinerary | grep -i 'itinerary'

stories.title: Add llms.txt File for AI Crawler Content Guidance
stories.description: Create a machine-readable /llms.txt file following AI crawler conventions (llms.txt spec). Include sections for blog content, Malaysia-Singapore job seeker resources, hostel booking, and visa run guides to improve visibility to Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT web search, and Perplexity.
acceptanceCriteria: File created at site/public/llms.txt with plaintext [About], [Blog], [Jobs], [Hostel], [Guides] sections
Each section contains brief description and links to related pages (/blog, /singapore-jobs, /visa-run, /rooms)
File served with Cache-Control: public, max-age=86400 header and valid UTF-8 encoding
technicalNotes: File to create: site/public/llms.txt (plaintext, not .md or .json)
Sections: [About] Pelangi Capsule Hostel JB, [Blog] Travel guides, [Jobs] Malaysia-Singapore work, [Hostel] Booking & rooms, [Guides] Visa, transport, shopping

stories.title: Create /singapore-jobs Resource Hub Page with FAQPage Schema
stories.description: Build a dedicated /singapore-jobs page serving Malaysian job seekers with FAQ JSON-LD schema containing 8-10 questions about work passes, visa runs, cross-border commuting, and gig economy. Include internal links to related blog posts (work pass guide, visa run, gig jobs).
acceptanceCriteria: Page renders at /singapore-jobs with hero section, FAQ accordion component, and hostel booking CTA button
FAQPage JSON-LD schema embedded with mainEntity type FAQPage, containing at least 8 question-answer pairs
FAQ section uses reusable <Accordion> component; each item has Question heading (h3) and Answer text
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/singapore-jobs/page.tsx (App Router, use generateMetadata for title/description)

Add FAQPage schema via <script type='application/ld+json'> with 8 questions: work pass types, visa run length, remote work legality, gig jobs, cross-border commute time, accommodation for job seekers, salary expectations, renewal procedures
Test command: curl http://localhost:3000/singapore-jobs | grep -c '"mainEntity"' && npx next build --no-lint

stories.title: Add Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA to Public Forms
stories.description: Integrate Cloudflare Turnstile (managed CAPTCHA) into all public-facing forms (contact, booking, newsletter). Validate tokens server-side before processing. Include graceful fallback if widget fails to load.
acceptanceCriteria: Turnstile widget renders on /contact and /book form pages immediately above submit button with theme auto
Form submission calls server action that validates token via Turnstile API before processing (reject on invalid/expired token)
Fallback: if Turnstile fails to load, form shows warning but allows submission for manual review queue
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/components/ContactForm.tsx (import @react-turnstile/react, add <Turnstile ref={ref} />, capture onSuccess callback)
File to edit: site/src/app/api/contact/route.ts (validate token: fetch('https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/validate', { secret, response: token }))
Test command: npm test -- src/__tests__/forms.test.tsx --grep Turnstile && npx next build

stories.title: Implement TikTok Pixel and Event Tracking for Gen Z Analytics
stories.description: Add TikTok Pixel tracking to measure Gen Z hostel bookings and engagement. Fire events: PageView (auto), ViewContent (blog/room pages), Purchase (booking confirm) with value, currency, and item details.
acceptanceCriteria: TikTok Pixel script loads on all pages; PageView event fires on each route navigation automatically
Purchase event fires on booking confirmation with value, currency: 'MYR', content_id (roomId), and content_type: 'product'
Pixel ID and events appear in TikTok Events Manager dashboard within 24 hours of first booking
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/app/layout.tsx (add <script async src='https://analytics.tiktok.com/i18n/pixel/config/GTK{PIXEL_ID}.js'></script> or use next/third-parties)
File to create: site/src/lib/analytics-tiktok.ts (export trackTikTokPurchase(roomId, price) that calls window.ttk?.track('Purchase', { value, currency, content_id }))
Test command: npm run dev && open browser console, check for ttk pixel fire on /book page and booking form submit
